subject.title: feat(clients): adopt model controls, session management, and keyboard history recall on iOS

question: Should iOS make gateway-backed session groups canonical across every Sessions entry point, including migration or retirement of the device-local group catalog?
rationale: The existing reachable local catalog and the new gateway catalog represent competing persistence and UX contracts; selecting the long-term owner and migration behavior requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Unify on gateway groups
options.body: Move the remaining Sessions entry point to the shared gateway-backed implementation and define a narrow migration or retirement path for local-only groups.

options.title: Keep local groups intentionally
options.body: Retain the existing local catalog and keep the chat entry point on the same implementation until a separately designed cross-device group model is approved.

recommendation.title: Unify on gateway groups
recommendation.body: Move the remaining Sessions entry point to the shared gateway-backed implementation and define a narrow migration or retirement path for local-only groups.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns the merged shared session-management work and the iOS adoption path.
